h1: Fixture Robot A100 vs Fixture Robot B200: which one should you buy?
answer: Pick the Fixture Robot A100 if your home is mostly carpet and you share it with a shedding pet: it has the stronger suction and a self-emptying dock. Pick the Fixture Robot B200 if low sofas and beds are the problem: it is the slimmer of the two. Both are fictional placeholders, dated November 1, 2026.

picks.why: Stronger suction and a self-emptying dock mean fewer bin trips on carpet. It is the taller robot, so check the gap under your sofa first.
picks.bestFor: your floors are mostly carpet and a pet sheds year-round.

picks.why: The slimmer body slides under low beds and sofas that stop taller robots. Its bin is emptied by hand.
picks.bestFor: you have hard floors and furniture with little clearance.

criteria.name: Pickup on carpet
criteria.explanation: Suction and brush design decide how much pet hair a single pass lifts from carpet.

criteria.name: Fits under furniture
criteria.explanation: A robot that cannot reach under the bed leaves the dustiest spot untouched.

criteria.name: Upkeep
criteria.explanation: A self-emptying dock and washable parts cut the weekly chores.

sections.h2: Three differences that matter at home
sections.html:
The two placeholders differ where owners notice it most.

  • Carpet: the A100 has the stronger suction.
  • Clearance: the B200 is 0.8 in slimmer.
  • Upkeep: only the A100 empties itself.
Neither placeholder needs an app subscription. Replacement bags apply to the A100 dock only.
